quarterly_data.quarter: Planet Labs press release: Planet Opens State-of-the-Art Satellite Manufacturing in (09-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Planet opened its satellite manufacturing facility in Berlin (5,700 square meters): facility handover and cleanroom fit-out are done, production of its 300 kg class, 30-cm resolution class Pelican satellites is scheduled to start this autumn, the first satellite is scheduled to be complete before the end of the year, and the facility can scale to up to 60 satellites per year; Planet will add 70 employees to its team of nearly 150 in Berlin. The first Berlin-built Pelicans are scheduled to launch on an Isar Aerospace Spectrum vehicle in early 2027. CEO Will Marshall: Planet has built and launched 688 satellites in 15 years. Planet's ground station network across Germany, the UK, Norway and Iceland downlinks nearly 50% of all its satellite data, and Europe is home to over 30% of its global workforce.
quarterly_data.figure: 5,700-square-meter facility; up to 60 satellites per year; 70 employees added to nearly 150
